name: tia_create_user_constant
description: Create a supported PLC user constant in an exact tag table without overwriting existing constants.

constant_name.description: Name for the new user constant.

data_type.description: Supported type: Bool, SInt, Int, DInt, LInt, USInt, Byte, UInt, Word, UDInt, DWord, ULInt, LWord, Real, or LReal.

value.description: Invariant-culture literal value for the selected type.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact containing tag-table-group path; omit or use an empty string for the root group.
